Why the bot is not trading
best training config is not profitable after costs

Costs modelled at 0.6 % taker fee per side plus spread and slippage. On hourly bars gross edges were consumed by costs; daily rules produced too few trades to be statistically meaningful.

Long-only spot, no leverage, no shorting.
Signals decided at bar close; fills at next bar open with fee + half-spread + slippage per side.
Fee/spread/slippage presets are assumptions (see src/bot/costs.ts); min order from venue metadata when available.
Historical candles are indicative; executable depth was not verified.
Bonferroni alpha uses the cumulative number of candidates (all earlier registry entries + this run).
Recent history already inspected by earlier tests on the same market/timeframe (even with refreshed data) is not fresh evidence: such candidates cannot qualify without forward paper results.
Universe = coins that are large and listed today (survivorship bias). Measured in research/survivorship-study.json; qualification also requires a non-negative median on delisted markets.
Research capital normalised to $1,000; account-size feasibility evaluated separately.

HELIX has no server and collects no personal data. Your paper account, alerts, watched addresses and the encrypted wallet vault stay on this device.

The app talks directly to public data providers from your device (Coinbase, CoinGecko, Blockstream / mempool.space, Etherscan, Solana RPC, and GitHub Pages for research results). Like any website, they can see your IP address.
On Android, app data is excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.

HELIX provides live market data, paper trading with simulated money, a research-only trading bot that places no orders, and a self-custody wallet whose keys stay encrypted on your device.
No real-money trading, no custody of your funds and no financial advice. In this private beta the wallet does not sign or broadcast any transaction.
Simulated and backtested results are not earnings and do not predict future results.
